subject: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC)
exam_context: CAT 2026 - VARC section only, 24 questions / 72 marks / 40 minutes
data_provenance: Estimated from slot-wise PYQ analyses of CAT 2021-2025 aggregated by multiple coaching trackers, not an official IIM-published weightage document; last grounded Sep 2026. Composition shifts slightly year to year (e.g. CAT 2024 added a 4th RC passage vs. earlier years' 3), so treat as a multi-year average for question-bank planning.

V01.notes: Argumentative and analytical passages dominate over narrative/descriptive ones; inference and 'except' questions are the hardest, direct-detail questions the easiest.

V02.notes: TITA format in most recent slots removes the guessing safety net of options, raising effective difficulty.

V03.notes: Generally considered one of the more scorable VA sub-types when the main idea is grasped correctly.

V04.area: Odd Sentence Out / Para Completion / Para Insertion
V04.notes: Odd-one-out is consistently flagged by trackers as the toughest VA sub-type.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources reporting on the CAT 2025 (30 Nov 2025) session, consistent with the CAT 2024 pattern.
marking_scheme.mcq: +3 for a correct answer, -1 for an incorrect answer, 0 if unattempted.
marking_scheme.tita: +3 for a correct answer, 0 for an incorrect answer (no negative marking), 0 if unattempted.
marking_scheme.question_types_used: Single-correct MCQ and TITA (type-in-the-answer). No multiple-correct or matrix-match formats.
